crossRefs.note: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic…
Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

parallels.note: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic…
For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk?’
Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”
“Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk?’
I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

translations.web: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
translations.bsb: Then Jesus said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
translations.asv: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
